<head-word>דָּגָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="D00118">next w.</xref>) 
<italic>pile; grain, bread, bread-stuff</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 10 דְּגָנוֹ של עולם are the store of the world. Tosef. Ber. IV, 15; Y. ib. VI, 10
<sup>b</sup> הד' שהוא וכ' the more preferable kind of bread. Tosef. l. c. כל שהוא מין שבע ואינו מין ד' whatever belongs to the seven produces (Deut. VIII, 8) but not to breadstuffs; Bab. ib. 37
<sup>b</sup>. Pes. III, 1; a. fr.—Ned. VII, 2 הנודר מן הד' וכ' he who vows abstinence from 
<italic>dagan</italic>, is forbidden dry Egyptian beans, v. next w.—
<plural-form>Pl. דְּגָנִים</plural-form>. Pesik. R. s. 41 מנפף את הד' swells the grains; (Yalk. Ps. 755 מנפנף את רגליה, read דְּגָנֶיהָ). Tosef. Ber. VII (VI), 8 Var.—בֵּית דָּ' pr. n. pl. 
<italic>Beth-Dagan</italic> in Judea. Tosef. Ohol. III, 9. [Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 2, v. דָּגוֹן.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00131">
<head-word>דדי, </head-word>
<head-word>דָּדָה</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. זוּז)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to move nimbly, hop, trip</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. דִּדָּה</plural-form></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to walk, pull</italic> (a young child or beast unable to walk by itself).</definition>
<notes> Sabb. XVIII, 2 מְדַדִּין עגלין וכ' you may lead or pull calves &c. (on the Sabbath). Ib. אשה מְדַדָּה וכ' a mother may walk her child. Ib. 128
<sup>b</sup> דוחין אין מדדין לא push you may, but make them hop, no. Pes. IV, 7 (55
<sup>b</sup>) מְדַרִּין ומחזירין וכ' Ar. (ed. only מחזירין). Sabb. 88
<sup>b</sup> and the angels מְדַדִּין אותך led them (the frightened Israelites) back; א"ת ידודון אלא יְדַדּוּן read not (Ps. LXVIII, 13) 
<italic>yiddodun</italic> but 
<italic>y’daddun</italic> (they led them). Cant. R. to VIII, 11 the angels מְדַדִּין להם וכ' led the Israelites away, והיו מִדַּדִּין לפני וכ' and they themselves tripped timidly before the Lord, v. infra. Y. Sabb. XVII, end, 16
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Erub. X, 26
<sup>c</sup> top מְדַדֵּהוּ וכ' he makes the bolt slide with his finger tips. Cant. R. to IV, 8 [read:] אדין מְדַדֵּם ואינם וכ' He had just been leading them (through the Red Sea), and they should 
<pgbrk id="pg281" />not trust?—ד' פיתקין 
<italic>to shake stones</italic> (
<italic>ballots</italic>), i.e. 
<italic>to protest against</italic>. Esth. R. to I, 2 מה"ש מְדַדִּין פיתקין וכ' the angels protested against the Lord’s decision; Cant. R. to VIII, 11 יִדּוֹדוּן בהם ממדדין פיטקין (read מדדין) they (the angels) were excited against them, they protested (ref. to Joel IV, 3).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִדַּדָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to hop, trip</italic> (of young or tied birds).</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 25
<sup>b</sup> אי מִידַּדִּין Ms. M. (ed. אי בְמִדַּ') if the tied birds (deposited in a certain place) hop from spot to spot. B. Bath. 23

<entry id="D00149">

<head-word>(רָהוֹן, </head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="D00151">דְּהֵין</xref>) 
<italic>fattening substance, urin-soaked dung; a concrete of dung used for vessels</italic>, cmp. גָּלָל.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>b</sup> bot. אהן ד' של מימי וכ' a vessel made of dung prepared with urin absorbs no liquids.—Gen. R. s. 39, end (ref. to 
<italic>Bethel</italic>, changed into 
<italic>Beth-aven</italic>, Josh. VII, 2) [read:] לא זכתה … בית העמל הרי … בית העמד תמן קריין לפועלא טבא עמילא (ולהִרְהוּן) ולדהון … עמידה she did not deserve even to be named 
<italic>Beth Heamal</italic> (house of toil, cmp. עמל ואון Ps. XC, 10), now she is named 
<italic>Beth-Heamad</italic> (dung-house); there (in Samaria, Galilee &c.) they call the good laborer 
<italic>amela</italic> (the industrious, v. עמל), and the dung prepared with urin

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>

<sup>a</sup> ד' לדורות a sample (of great fertility) as a lesson for future generations. Sabb. 30

Job XXXVI, 7 עיניו) ד' דידהו that which is like his own doing, i.e. some realization of his ideal, v. עֵינָא; Midr. Sam. ch. XXVIII דוגמה דידהון; Gen. R. s. 71 דוגמת דידיה (corr. acc.), v. next w.; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. דּוּגְמוֹת</plural-form>. B. Kam. 119
